title: finding(studio): the dashboard  zh overlay now translates a sentence the spec no longer says, and its citation comment quotes the retired string
body:
Filed by the objectstack dev working objectstack-ai/objectstack#14586, per the rule that the seat landing a change whose product flows to another repo opens the follow-up there. Unassigned, for objectui triage.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#14586

## What changed upstream

That card rewrites **both** producer strings for the dashboard `gap` field, because "Tailwind units" named a CSS library the app author never chose and cannot act on. Exact before/after, so nothing here needs re-deriving:

| producer | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.form.ts` `helpText` | `Grid gap (Tailwind units)` | `Space between widgets, in steps of 0.25rem (4 = 1rem)` |
| `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` `.describe()` | `Grid gap in Tailwind spacing units` | `Space between widgets, in steps of 0.25rem (4 = 1rem)` |

The magnitude was kept deliberately: the dashboard renderer sets the grid gap as an inline style computed from the key (`DashboardRenderer.tsx`, `gap: ${gap * 0.25}rem`), so one step is exactly 0.25rem and every accepted value is linear.

## Two things on this side the change reaches

**1. A citation that is now false.** `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts:87-89`:

```
// The spec's own hint here is `Grid gap (Tailwind units)` — a unit
// only a developer can act on. Reported upstream rather than
// "translated" literally; this says what the author can decide.
```

The upstream hint is no longer that string, and "reported upstream" now describes a report that has been acted on. A comment quoting a retired upstream literal reads as current fact to the next person.

**2. The overlay itself — the judgement triage asked for.** `:90`:

```
gap: { label: '间距', helpText: '组件之间的间距，数值越大越松' },
```

Triage's question upstream was whether this overlay is still a translation of the source sentence or has become an unrelated improvement, and if the two converged, whether it is needed at all. What can now be measured:

- **Converged on intent.** Both now name what the author decides rather than the renderer's unit.
- **NOT converged on content.** The new English carries the magnitude (one step is 0.25rem, so 4 is 1rem); the overlay carries only a direction (数值越大越松). A zh author can no longer compute a size the English reader can.

So "delete the overlay, the source is fixed" is available but not free: it swaps a Chinese sentence that says less for an English one that says more. Restating the magnitude in the overlay is the other option. That trade-off is the objectui seat's call, which is why this is a card and not a patch.

## Related, not duplicate

- objectstack-ai/objectui#7369 — the architectural end-state (inspector consumes the platform-localized form/bundle, this overlay table deleted). If that lands first, item 2 dissolves into it; item 1 is a stale citation either way.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#14931 — the same class upstream, in the platform's own zh-CN bundle.

No objectui file was touched from the upstream card.
